description.description: Optional longer text for the release (e.g. storefront, listings, liner notes).

items.description: All content belonging to this release, in display order.

uri.description: AT-URI of the catalog.item.digital record for this content.

cid.description: Optional CID of the item record at time of collection authoring. Informational only.

role.description: The function of this item within the release. track = music recording. document = liner notes, lyrics, zine, PDF. video = music video or visual album component. artwork = supplementary visual asset. bonus = promotional or discretionary extra.

essential.description: If true, this item is a core component of the release — included in the collection zip and per-item download entitlement. If false, the item is supplementary and delivery is at the backend's discretion.

trackNumber.description: Position in the tracklist. Meaningful only for role: track.

discNumber.description: Disc number for multi-disc releases. Meaningful only for role: track.

title.description: Display title override for this item's role in the collection. Falls back to the item record's own title if absent.

defaultLicenseUri.description: AT-URI of the default license.terms record for this collection. Used to pre-populate the listing form. Not the authoritative license at point of sale — the listing's licenseUri field is authoritative.

upc.description: Universal Product Code. Optional — may be absent if not yet registered. See bazaarPid for self-issued alternative.

bazaarPid.description: Self-issued Product Identifier. Generated as base32(SHA-256(artistDid + collectionUri + releaseDate)). Shadows UPC. supersededByUpc populated when a proper UPC is obtained.
